article_outsourced_brain.summary: Navigation apps remember routes so we do not have to, search engines answer so we do not wonder, and AI now writes so we do not think. This article examines cognitive offloading: when delegating thinking to tools is smart, when it quietly erodes the ability to think, and how to keep the mental muscles that no tool can exercise for you.
article_outsourced_brain.title: The Outsourced Brain: When People Stop Thinking for Themselves
